## Oh Hey! I'm Marie

Welcome to my page 🤠 🎮!!

I'm an early-career data scientist who enjoys exploring datasets, spatial data, and creating visualizations that communicate findings so everyone can understand them. I recently completed my Master's in Environmental Data Science at the Bren School, University of California, Santa Barbara.
:::
